name: ServicesLedger
description: Services as a ruled ledger: index, offer, description and capabilities per row, with a Human / Machine switch that shows the same offers as plain text.

keyboard: Tab reaches the Human / Machine view switch as one stop (arrow keys, Home and End change the view), then each row link.
ariaRequirements: The section is labelled by its heading.
The view switch is the SegmentedControl radiogroup, named by the view label; each option reports aria-checked.
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-10-31: reviewed live in Storybook (Default, both views). The section is labelled by its h2; the Human / Machine switch is a labelled radiogroup (roving tabindex, arrow keys move and select); the ledger is an ordered list whose rows are single links. Each link's name is the whole row on purpose: WCAG 2.5.3 (Label in Name) needs the name to contain the visible text, and naming it by the title alone fails axe label-content-name-mismatch. The index numbers are aria-hidden; the machine view's copy button announces Copied through aria-live; Tab order runs switch, rows, then the machine view links and copy button.
